AMENDMENTTOZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT This Amendment to Zoning Lot and Development Agreement ( this “Amendment Agreement'") is made this 3 day of January 2014, by and between SC WATERVIEW LLC ("SC Waterview-Water Street"), a New York limited liability company, having a business address at 420 Great Neck Road, Great Neck, NY 11021, and HHLP PEARL STREET ASSOCIATES LLC ("HHLP-Pearl Street"), a New York limited liability company, having a business address at 44 Hersha Drive, Harrisburg, PA 17102. WITNESSTHTHAT A. SC Waterview-Water Street is the fee owner of 6 Water Street, in the County, State, and City of New York, which property is shown on the tax map of the City of New York as Lot 51 in Block 8 (the "SC Waterview-Water Street Property"). B. HHLP-Pearl Street is the fee owner of32 Pearl Street,in the County,State, and City of New York, which property is shown on the tax map of the City of New York as Lot 39 in Block 8 (the “"HHLP-Pearl Street Property"). · C. Pursuant to that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions made by SC Waterview LLC, dated as of February 19, 2008 and recorded on March 12, 2008 City Register Filing Number 2008000100780, the SC-Waterview-Water Street Property and the HHLP-Pearl Street Property have been merged into a single combined zoning lot (the "Combined Zoning Lot"). D. The properties at 6 Water Street and 32 Pearl Street are subject to that certain Zoning Lot and Development Agreement, dated May 4, 2011, and recorded on May 18, 2011, at City Register Filing Number 2011000180326 (the “ZLDA"), which among other    ,    (     n

development rights under the New.York City Zoning Resolution (the “Retained Floor Area Development Rights"), which amount includes the floor area in the existing building on the HHLP-Pearl Street Property, and transfers and allocates all of the “floor area" and related development rights appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot in excess of the Retained Floor Area Development Rights (the “Developer Floor Area Development Rights") to SC Waterview-Water Street, as owner of the SC Waterview-Water Street Property. E. HHLP-Pearl Street is the successor in interest to SC Waterview Pearl Street under the Zoning Lot and Development Agreement and HHLP-Pearl Street was a participant in the negotiation of that agreement, intending to acquire the HHLP-Pearl Street Property. F. Since then HHLP-Pearl Street has acquired the HHLP-Pearl Street Property by deed               2011000270117. G.SCWaterview-WaterStreet and HHLP-Pearl Street intended then and intend now that the ZLDA provide that any new building upon the SC Waterview-Water Street Property be permitted to cantilever above the HHLP-Pearl Street Property. .H.SC Waterview-Water Street and HHLP-Pearl Street desire to amend the ZLDA in certain respects, including by specifically providing for such cantilever.
